title: rest: the same missing manage_metadata capability is refused with two envelopes and two codes (FORBIDDEN vs PERMISSION_DENIED)
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: as a member without `manage_metadata`: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/<name>?mode=draft` → 403 `{"error":{"code":"FORBIDDEN","message":"Saving a metadata item requires the `manage_metadata` capability."}}`; `DELETE /api/v1/packages/<id>` → 403 `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","message":"Managing packages requires the `manage_metadata` capability.","httpStatus":403}}`.

**Who acts on it:** objectstack triage (REST / error vocabulary owner). ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

The same refusal — missing `manage_metadata` — comes back with two envelope shapes and two codes depending on the route family. Clients must special-case both.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Pick the ADR-0112 code for a missing capability and one envelope; align the packages routes with the metadata routes.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *console handles FORBIDDEN and PERMISSION_DENIED refusal codes differently missing capability*: 3 hits (0 open, 3 closed).

  - objectstack-ai/objectstack#21405 (closed) — same 'one refusal, two door answers' family, different route
  - objectstack-ai/objectstack#8013 (closed) — permission-denied envelope on a metadata route; neighbouring
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
